Placeholder Firebase config is treated as configured. Evidence: `loadFirebaseConfig` only rejects missing or placeholder `projectId` at `dashboard/config-firebase.js:46`; passing `JARVIS_A6EE1_CONFIG_TEMPLATE` returns the `REPLACE_*` apiKey/appId/sender values. Browser bootstrap does not guarantee static first paint before realtime attaches. Evidence: `index-firebase.html:51` waits one timeout, but `core.js:199` starts async page imports and calls `Jarvis.init()` later without exposing an awaitable ready signal. Recommendation: expose/await a `Jarvis.ready` promise or fire an initialized event after `loadState()` and initial render, then attach Firebase.

The documented local Firebase config file is not gitignored. Evidence: `config-firebase.example.js` tells operators to copy real config to `firebase-config.local.js`, but `git check-ignore -v dashboard/firebase-config.local.js` returned no match. Recommendation: add `dashboard/firebase-config.local.js` to `.gitignore`.
